correctness.rationale: For the narrowed all-plane theorem, BB^T=B^TB=sI+J and line sums s+1 imply an invariant constant/sum-zero splitting because v=1 in characteristic three. On constants the adjacency swaps shores and the two wave blocks are genuine J_2(+1), J_2(-1), giving the claimed parity/3-adic contribution for all t. The sum-zero adjacency A_W has square zero and rank 2(rho-1)>0 (otherwise distinct binary incidence columns would coincide). On the doubled sum-zero sector D=diag(A_W,A_W) commutes with T and T^2+I=TD. Thus (T^2+I)^2=0, so Bezout against X^t-1 yields zero fixed space for 4 not dividing t. In characteristic three T^4-I=(TD)(I+TD)=TD; it has square zero and rank 4(rho-1), so the fourth-multiple dimensions are 4(v-rho) or 4(v-1) according as 3 does not divide or divides the time. This proof avoids the frozen shorthand that X^2+1 is irreducible in characteristic three: it is irreducible over F_3, but splits in even-degree extensions. Nonzero kernel vectors in the sum-zero sector have period four, outside vectors have period twelve, and the two blocks on constants realize 1,2,3,6; no other periods divide the global order. This proves both the census by inversion and the rank formula. Independent replay: python3 /workspace/branches/plane_wave_reproduction.py; modular continuants with an independent bitmask row-space calculation checked all times up to the global order at s=2,3,4,5,7. The relevant s=3 example gives rho=7 and divisor-time dimensions (1,2,2,26,4,52); the other examples corroborate the frozen original as context. A finite example is not the universal proof.

value.rationale: The divisibility hypothesis is the structural boundary where the two sum-zero incidence Gram blocks vanish and their ranks cease to follow from the plane order. In this regime the wave gives an exact rank observable at the earliest rank-bearing iterate and determines the full primitive census from that same rank, uniformly without a Desarguesian hypothesis. This is a motivated missing regime of a natural finite-geometry family, not a parameter substitution or recomputation of the previously covered two regimes.
